representedDate: Standing historic market at UNESCO component 1346-001, with current native layout controls and estimates for historic roofs.
wholePhysicalScope: Main UNESCO bazaar boundary with native surveyed covered paths, building polygons and named courtyard openings. The covered ways and open courts are preserved in the modeled roof areas.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the principal market roofscape, brick domes and Amir and central roofed spines. Near levels add the complete mapped covered weave, individual stalls, oculi, brick ribs and caravanserai facades.
limitations: The connected market center is the scope. Separately listed Blue Mosque and Sorkhab components and unrelated buildings outside it are excluded.

Precise vault details are represented from standing documented types with a limited set of named hall anchors. Unsurveyed roof and column heights, fittings, roof forms and individual shop layouts are estimated.
Exterior roof blocks and the covered circulation are represented. Interior fabrics, exhibits and many minor secondary shops are simplified.
Additional shop wings around the surveyed open courtyards use inferred outlines. Their roof heights follow the nomination’s descriptions of the standing ensembles.
